_comment: Artifacts that exist with ZERO consumers, already known. This list may only SHRINK.
A NEW zero-consumer artifact fails the gate; an entry here that has since gained a
consumer ALSO fails, so this cannot become a place findings go to be forgotten.
Regenerate deliberately with --write-baseline; never to make a red run green.
@bsuite/workflow-canvas (added 2026-09-01, v0.1.0) is here for a reason the gate's own
'wire it or remove it' cannot yet accept: NO CONSUMER IS POSSIBLE UNTIL IT IS PUBLISHED.
Every app is a submodule built standalone on Vercel, which has no parent directory, so
an app may never depend on a package through `workspace:` or `file:../packages/*` - it
must resolve the published tarball. The package cannot be published until this lands on
main. So the ordering is publish, then wire, and there is no arrangement in which the
first consumer ships in the same PR as the package itself. Its consumer is the crm7
This entry expires by construction: the moment that route imports it, the gate FAILS on
a stale entry and forces the removal.
